title: haris18s/markerphylo pipeline - params.input schema
description: Schema for the file provided with params.input

sample.errorMessage: Sample name must be provided and cannot contain spaces

accession.errorMessage: Accession must be an NCBI assembly accession, e.g. GCF_000008485.1
